summary.text: Maggie Nurrenbern, a Democrat, represents Missouri Senate District 17 in Clay County; she was elected in 2024.
She previously served in the Missouri House of Representatives, elected in 2020 from District 15.

paragraphs.text: Nurrenbern is a lifelong Clay County resident and a 2002 graduate of Smithville High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Truman State University in Communication: Journalism and interned in the Missouri Senate in 2006.
She then joined the Peace Corps and spent two years working in public health and education in El Chaco, Ecuador.

After returning she earned a Spanish teaching certificate, a master's degree in Curriculum and Instruction and a TESOL endorsement from UMKC, and taught Spanish, journalism and English language learners at University Academy in Kansas City and North Kansas City High School.
She is a board member for Feed Northland Kids and a mother of three sons, Luke, Eli and Henry.
